company.name: Trelleborg Sealing Solutions
company.description: Division of Trelleborg AB specialising in precision sealing solutions for demanding industrial applications including automotive, aerospace, industrial, healthcare, and food & beverage sectors.

values.Z05: Sales Opportunity — TSS standard sales cycle

SalesCyclePhaseCode.description: Stage in the TSS sales funnel (Miller Heiman-style phases)
SalesCyclePhaseCode.note: Higher phase = further along the sales funnel. Phase Z07 is near-launch or post-award.

OpportunityLevel_KUT.description: Strategic level / complexity of the opportunity at TSS

BUS_SEG_CDE_KUT.description: Business segment — the market/industry the customer operates in

CustomerABCClassificationCode_PSM.description: Customer importance classification (PSM = Partner & Segment Management)

values.A: A class — Strategic / top-tier key account
values.G: G class — Global key account (highest tier, managed globally)

Channel_KUT.description: Sales channel through which the opportunity is being pursued

values.151: Sales (direct sales by TSS sales team)

MKT_SEG_CODE.description: Market segment code — detailed sub-segment within the business segment

examples.C1: C1 - Light Vehicle Manufacturers (passenger car OEMs)

MKT_SEG_GRP_CDE_KUT.description: Market segment group code — broader grouping above MKT_SEG_CODE
MKT_SEG_GRP_CDE_KUT.note: Groups multiple market segments under a common theme (e.g. P36A groups automotive platform segments)

CONGLOCODE_KUT.description: Conglomerate code — identifies the corporate group/parent of the customer account

examples.note: Used to aggregate revenue across all subsidiaries of a global customer group

ZBaseCurrency_KUTContent_KUT.description: Expected revenue converted to EUR base currency for cross-org comparison. Always EUR. Use this field when comparing revenue across different sales organisations with different local currencies.

ZConfidential_SDK.description: Boolean flag — true if this opportunity has been marked confidential. Confidential opportunities should not be shared externally.

PrimaryContactPartyName.description: Name of the primary contact person at the customer organisation (prospect side). This is the key stakeholder or decision-maker TSS is working with.

ProbabilityPercent.note: At TSS, opportunities above 75% are considered near-certain wins. Below 25% are considered at risk or early stage. Many opportunities are set to 0% when not yet formally qualified.

ExpectedRevenueAmount.description: Expected annual deal value in the local opportunity currency (see ExpectedRevenueAmountCurrencyCode). Prefer ZBaseCurrency_KUTContent_KUT (EUR) for cross-org comparison.
ExpectedRevenueAmount.note: Currency varies by sales org (USD for Americas, EUR for Europe, etc.)

ExpectedProcessingEndDate.description: Expected SOP (Start of Production) or deal close date — when revenue is expected to begin flowing from this opportunity

ZHasCompetitor_KUT.description: Boolean — true if a named competitor has been logged against this opportunity. Opportunities with competitors logged are more contested.

ZHasSummary_KUT.description: Boolean — true if the sales rep has added a written summary/note to the opportunity. false = opportunity not yet documented, a data quality gap.

ZHasSupplier_KUT.description: Boolean — true if a supplier (e.g. raw material partner) has been linked to the opportunity.

ResultReasonCode.description: Reason code for why an opportunity was Won or Lost. Populated when LifeCycleStatusCode = 3 (Won) or 5 (Lost).
ResultReasonCode.note: Key for win/loss analysis. Missing result reason = data quality gap.

sales_organisations.description: TSS sales organisations (CSCs = Customer Service Centres) in C4C. The SalesOrganisationID maps to a human-readable name.

business_rules.win_rate_benchmark: A win rate above 30% is considered healthy at TSS. Top performers achieve 40–50%. Below 20% indicates pipeline quality issues.
business_rules.typical_sales_cycle_months: 12–36 months for automotive (long lead time to SOP). 3–12 months for industrial. 6–18 months for aerospace.
data_completeness_rules: ZHasSummary_KUT = false means the sales rep has not documented the opportunity — flag as data quality gap
ProbabilityPercent = 0 means the opportunity has not been formally qualified yet
Missing ResultReasonCode on Won/Lost opportunities = data quality gap
Missing ExpectedProcessingEndDate = opportunity not yet at proposal stage
ZConfidential_SDK = true means restrict details in external-facing reports

terminology.SOP: Start of Production — the date the customer begins using TSS sealing components in their manufacturing process. This is the key milestone for automotive opportunities.
terminology.CSC: Customer Service Centre — TSS term for a regional sales organisation (same as SalesOrganisationName in C4C)
terminology.KUT: Key User Text field — SAP C4C extension fields added by TSS (visible as field names ending in _KUT or _SDK)
terminology.OBO: On Behalf Of — used in authentication context (principal propagation / OAuth2SAMLBearerAssertion)
terminology.ESAC: Expected Sales After Contract — EUR-denominated projected annual revenue broken out by year (EsacExpectedSalesYear1-5_KUT fields)
terminology.AutoHub: Automotive Hub — TSS regional hub managing all automotive segment opportunities for a geography (e.g. TSS Auto Europe = TSSEURAUTOHUB)
terminology.Pipeline: All active opportunities with LifeCycleStatusCode = 1 (Open) or 2 (In Process)
terminology.Conglomerate: Corporate parent group of a customer (CONGLOCODE_KUT) — used to track total exposure to a global group like Bosch or VW Group
terminology.G-class: G class customer (CustomerABCClassificationCode_PSM = G) = global key account, highest strategic tier at TSS
terminology.OOD: Out of Distribution — routing/territory classification code used in SALESTERRITORYDETCODE
terminology.Miller Heiman: Sales methodology used at TSS — phase codes Z01-Z07 map to Miller Heiman Blue Sheet phases
terminology.Base Currency: ZBaseCurrency_KUTContent_KUT — all opportunity amounts normalised to EUR for cross-currency comparison

reporting_guidance.default_date_filter: Opportunities with CreationDate >= 2025-06-05 (current data range in system)
reporting_guidance.preferred_amount_field: Use ZBaseCurrency_KUTContent_KUT (EUR) for revenue aggregation and comparison across orgs. Use ExpectedRevenueAmount only when showing local currency for a single org.
reporting_guidance.currency_note: ExpectedRevenueAmount is in local currency (USD for Americas, EUR for Europe, JPY for Japan etc). Always use ZBaseCurrency_KUTContent_KUT for cross-org totals.
reporting_guidance.geography_filtering: Filter by SalesOrganisationName or SalesOrganisationID. 'Germany' = TSSGERMANY + TSSINDSALGERMANY. 'Europe' includes all CSC Europe orgs plus TSSEURAUTOHUB. 'Auto' or 'Automotive' = TSSEURAUTOHUB + TSSNAAUTOHUB + orgs with BUS_SEG_CDE_KUT = AUT.
reporting_guidance.segment_filtering: BUS_SEG_CDE_KUT = 'AUT' for automotive, 'IND' for industrial, 'AER' for aerospace, 'HEA' for healthcare. MKT_SEG_CODE for sub-segments.
reporting_guidance.status_filtering: Active pipeline = LifeCycleStatusCode IN ('1','2'). Won = '3'. Lost = '5'. Exclude Lost when showing pipeline unless specifically asked.
data_quality_notes: ProbabilityPercent = 0 → not yet qualified, may be early pipeline
ZHasSummary_KUT = false → sales rep has not documented the opportunity
Large volumes of 0-probability deals inflate pipeline count without revenue credibility
ZConfidential_SDK = true → omit names/details from any external report
